{{RV|type=command

|game1= arma3
|version1= 2.04

|eff= local

|descr= Sets the shadow property of given marker.

|pr= [[setMarkerType]] will reset the shadow value to the one defined in marker type.

|gr1= Markers

|s1= marker [[setMarkerShadowLocal]] shadowState

|p1= marker: [[String]] - the marker

|p2= shadowState: [[Boolean]] - [[true]] to enable the shadow, [[false]] to disable it

|r1= [[Nothing]]

|x1= <sqf>_myMarker setMarkerShadowLocal true; // enable shadow</sqf>

|seealso= [[markerShadow]] [[setMarkerShadow]]
}}
